sampling.duplicatePolicy: unique messageId per producer and sensor
sampling.note: This is a workload contract, not a calibration certificate or claim about a physical device.

parameters.name: presence
parameters.meaning: room occupancy state; not identity or headcount

parameters.name: light
parameters.meaning: lighting on/off state; not illuminance in lux

parameters.name: energy_ac
parameters.meaning: synthetic AC energy increment for this sample interval; derived from assumed 1.5 kW while on

parameters.name: energy_lighting
parameters.meaning: synthetic lighting energy increment for this sample interval; derived from assumed 0.12 kW while on

parameters.name: energy_room_circuit
parameters.meaning: synthetic AC plus lighting energy increment for this sample interval

parameters.name: energy_total_room
parameters.meaning: synthetic total room energy increment, including an assumed 0.08 kW auxiliary load

parameters.name: noise_db
parameters.meaning: simulated room noise level; frequency weighting is unspecified

provenance.indoorMeasurements: synthetic, generated from a fixed seed and documented distributions
provenance.externalTemperature: WeatherAPI history/current endpoint, recorded separately as shared external observations
provenance.energyModel: synthetic interval deltas; assumed power values are workload-model parameters, not measured equipment performance
provenance.resolutionAndAccuracy: quantization is a generator choice; no physical sensor calibration accuracy is claimed
